ud5.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
ud5.9:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā māṇavakā bhagavato avidūre saddāyamānarūpā atikkamanti.
ud5.9:1.4: addasā kho bhagavā sambahule māṇavake avidūre saddāyamānarūpe atikkamante.
